about: Which configuration folder runs which tabs of the upload sheet (page/sheet_definition.json). page/workbook.py builds one request per record row and the page runs it through that folder's --run. A tab that is in no group here is reported as not set up yet. See the root CLAUDE.md > The upload sheet.

ask_on_refusal.about: Customers v2 (2026-10-26): a customer refused for one of these values is parked and the panel asks; the answer is checked with --answer-check (same path as Create)

link.about: A purpose row belongs to the customer whose link_name (record tab: Name; First Name + space + Last Name) equals Customer Name, ignoring case and extra spaces. Names must be unique within one sheet (never assumed unique in Oracle).

address_pick.about: Bill-to Site is a list in Oracle holding only this customer's one address, shown on Ship to rows only. Empty = picked automatically; a typed value must match the text built from the record's address (case and extra spaces ignored).

ask_on_refusal.about: An order type Oracle refuses for a value (nothing saved): the run asks right after it (suggestions, another value, or skip) and tries only that one again (2026-10-26)

unique_records.about: Oracle tells codes apart by case (Subscription exists in mixed case)
Oracle needs meanings unique within the list, capitals ignored

ask_on_refusal.about: A payment term Oracle's import refuses for a value (nothing saved): after the others, the run asks (suggestions, another value, or skip); an installment value goes into that installment; only that term is imported again (2026-10-26)

link.about: Exact: capitals and spaces count, as Oracle's own name check

ask_on_refusal.about: A lookup type or code Oracle refuses for a value (nothing saved): after the others, the run asks; a code value goes into that code row; only that one is sent again (2026-10-26)

orphans.about: Code rows whose type isn't on the Lookup Types tab: codes added to a type that exists in Oracle; the folder's --plan checks it exists and isn't a System type

reserved.text: {value} is the order type list: use the Order Types tab for these.
reserved.fix: Move these rows to the Order Types tab.

ask_on_refusal.about: A business unit Oracle refuses for a value: after the others are made, the run asks the user (suggested values, another value, or skip) and retries only that one (2026-10-26)

depends_on.note: On the Business Units tab of this sheet: {value} is created first; the price list waits until Oracle shows it for pricing.
depends_on.about: A price list on a business unit from the same upload runs after it (2026-10-26): it waits while that business unit waits for a decision, and is not sent when it failed or was skipped

ask_on_refusal.about: As Business Units: a price list Oracle refuses for a value gets a question after the others are made
